difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: in the strict-transform situation, a short exact sequence of quasi-coherent sheaves on X that stays exact after any base change has strict transforms relative to any blowup S' -> S that again form a short exact sequence (source lines 9036-9048). The proof localises to affine S and X and pushes the sheaves to S, reduces the blowup to the case of an effective Cartier divisor D in S, and translates the statement into algebra: for a universally exact sequence of A-modules the sequence of a-power-torsion submodules and quotients is exact; surjectivity and injectivity are immediate and the substance is exactness in the middle, proved by lifting a class through the universally injective map M_1 -> M_2.
